tools.name: book_taiga_meeting
tools.description: Create a confirmed Chat with Taiga meeting at an exact available start time. Call only after find_taiga_meeting_times and only after the user explicitly confirms the selected time, full name, work email, practice size, and IANA time zone. An optional meeting topic may be supplied; otherwise Taiga uses 'Discuss Taiga medical billing'. This sends the booking to Cal.com and triggers its normal confirmation email.

start.description: Exact ISO 8601 UTC start time returned by find_taiga_meeting_times.

practiceSize.description: Number of providers in the attendee's practice.

meetingTopic.description: Optional meeting purpose. Defaults to 'Discuss Taiga medical billing'.

timeZone.description: Attendee's IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

tools.name: find_taiga_meeting_times
tools.description: Find available times for Taiga's Chat with Taiga meeting. Use this before booking. Provide a future date range of 14 days or fewer and the attendee's IANA time zone. Returns exact ISO start times for the user to choose from; it does not create or hold a booking.

startDate.description: First date to search, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Last date to search, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Must be no more than 14 days after startDate.

timeZone.description: Attendee's IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.
